points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 凯恩斯出生于剑桥的一个学术世家，父亲是剑桥大学经济学家和哲学家。他在伊顿公学接受教育，展现出非凡的数学才能。这一时期，凯恩斯开始接触经济学思想，并对古典经济学产生质疑。他的早期教育奠定了其跨学科思维的基础，同时也培养了他对数学和逻辑的严谨态度，这对他后来发展宏观经济理论产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Born into an academic family in Cambridge, Keynes showed exceptional mathematical talent at Eton College. During this period, he began engaging with economic ideas and questioning classical economics. His early education fostered interdisciplinary thinking and developed his rigorous approach to mathematics and logic, which profoundly influenced his later development of macroeconomic theory.

points.title: 学术起步
points.description: 1908年，凯恩斯回到剑桥大学担任经济学讲师，开始其学术生涯。他积极参与剑桥学术圈，与罗素、维特根斯坦等思想家交往。这一时期，凯恩斯开始发表经济学论文，逐渐形成自己的理论框架。1911年，他成为《经济学杂志》编辑，开始影响经济学界。1913年，他出版《印度货币与金融》，展现了对货币问题的深刻理解，为其后来的理论发展奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Returning to Cambridge in 1908 as a lecturer in economics, Keynes began his academic career. He actively participated in the Cambridge intellectual circle, engaging with thinkers like Russell and Wittgenstein. During this period, Keynes started publishing economic papers and gradually developed his theoretical framework. In 1911, he became editor of the Economic Journal, beginning to influence the economics profession. His 1913 book 'Indian Currency and Finance' demonstrated his deep understanding of monetary issues.

points.title: 战时经历
points.description: 第一次世界大战爆发后，凯恩斯进入英国财政部工作，负责处理战争融资问题。这段经历让他深入了解了政府财政运作和经济政策制定的实际过程。1919年，作为英国代表团成员参加巴黎和会，他对《凡尔赛条约》的苛刻条件提出强烈批评，认为这将导致德国经济崩溃和欧洲不稳定。这一观点在其著作《和约的经济后果》(1919)中系统阐述，使他一举成名，也奠定了其作为经济政策批评者的声誉。
points.descriptionEn: With the outbreak of WWI, Keynes joined the British Treasury, handling war financing issues. This experience gave him deep insights into government fiscal operations and economic policy formulation. In 1919, as a British delegate to the Paris Peace Conference, he strongly criticized the harsh terms of the Treaty of Versailles, arguing they would lead to German economic collapse and European instability. This view was systematically articulated in his book 'The Economic Consequences of the Peace' (1919), which brought him fame and established his reputation as an economic policy critic.

points.title: 理论创新
points.description: 战后，凯恩斯回到剑桥继续学术研究，同时积极参与金融投资活动。1923年，他出版《货币改革短论》，提出货币管理思想。1924年，他发表《路易斯·卡罗勒的经济后果》，讽刺古典经济学假设。1926年，他在《自由放任的终结》一文中挑战自由市场教条。1930年，他出版《货币论》，进一步发展其货币理论。这一时期最重大的成就是1936年出版《就业、利息和货币通论》，彻底挑战了古典经济学，提出政府干预经济的必要性，标志着现代宏观经济学的诞生。
points.descriptionEn: After the war, Keynes returned to Cambridge for academic research while actively participating in financial investments. In 1923, he published 'A Tract on Monetary Reform' proposing monetary management ideas. His 1924 essay 'The Economic Consequences of Mr. Keynes' satirized classical economic assumptions. In 1926, he challenged free-market orthodoxy in 'The End of Laissez-Faire.' His 1930 work 'A Treatise on Money' further developed his monetary theory. The most significant achievement of this period was the 1936 publication of 'The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money,' which fundamentally challenged classical economics and proposed the necessity of government intervention, marking the birth of modern macroeconomics.

points.title: 政策影响
points.description: 第二次世界大战期间，凯恩斯再次进入英国财政部，担任经济顾问，为战时经济政策提供理论支持。1940年，他发表《如何为战争付费》，提出战时融资方案。1942年，他被授予贵族爵位，成为凯恩斯男爵。战后，他积极参与布雷顿森林体系的构建，主张建立国际货币基金组织和世界银行，以促进战后经济稳定。1944年，他率领英国代表团参加布雷顿森林会议，虽然未能完全实现其国际清算联盟的构想，但他的思想对战后国际经济秩序的形成产生了深远影响。1946年，他在多塞特郡去世，但其经济学思想已成为战后经济政策制定的核心指导原则。
points.descriptionEn: During WWII, Keynes rejoined the British Treasury as an economic advisor, providing theoretical support for wartime economic policy. In 1940, he published 'How to Pay for the War' proposing wartime financing solutions. In 1942, he was elevated to the peerage as Baron Keynes. After the war, he actively participated in the creation of the Bretton Woods system, advocating for the establishment of the IMF and World Bank to promote post-war economic stability. In 1944, he led the British delegation to the Bretton Woods Conference. Although he couldn't fully realize his vision for an International Clearing Union, his ideas profoundly influenced the formation of the post-war international economic order. Keynes died in Dorset in 1946, but his economic thinking had become central to post-war economic policy formulation.

supporter.zh: 凯恩斯被誉为20世纪最具影响力的经济学家之一，他的理论为现代宏观经济学奠定了基础。支持者认为他拯救了资本主义制度，通过政府干预有效应对经济危机。凯恩斯主义政策在二战后被广泛采用，促进了战后经济繁荣。他强调的财政政策和需求管理成为各国政府应对经济波动的重要工具，为无数人提供了就业机会和经济安全感。凯恩斯的思想体现了经济学作为一门实用科学的本质，将理论创新与实际问题解决紧密结合。
supporter.en: Keynes is regarded as one of the most influential economists of the 20th century, whose theories laid the foundation for modern macroeconomics. Supporters believe he saved capitalism by effectively addressing economic crises through government intervention. Keynesian policies were widely adopted after WWII, fostering post-war economic prosperity. His emphasis on fiscal policy and demand management became essential tools for governments to handle economic fluctuations, providing employment opportunities and economic security for millions. Keynes's work embodies the practical nature of economics, tightly linking theoretical innovation with problem-solving.

critic.zh: 批评者认为凯恩斯理论存在根本性缺陷，过度强调政府干预可能导致通货膨胀和资源错配。哈耶克、弗里德曼等经济学家指出，凯恩斯主义忽视了市场机制的自我调节能力，长期实施会导致政府过度膨胀和经济效率下降。此外，凯恩斯对短期经济稳定的关注牺牲了长期经济增长，其理论未能充分预见滞胀现象。批评者还认为，凯恩斯主义政策为政治干预经济提供了借口，可能导致政府债务累积和经济自由度降低。
critic.en: Critics argue that Keynesian theory has fundamental flaws, with excessive government intervention potentially leading to inflation and resource misallocation. Economists like Hayek and Friedman pointed out that Keynesian economics overlooks the self-regulating capacity of markets, and its long-term implementation could result in government overreach and reduced economic efficiency. Additionally, Keynes's focus on short-term stability sacrifices long-term growth, and his theories failed to adequately predict stagflation. Critics also contend that Keynesian policies provide justification for political intervention in the economy, potentially leading to government debt accumulation and reduced economic freedom.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，凯恩斯被视为经济学思想史上的转折点人物，他成功地将经济学从微观个体行为转向宏观经济总量分析。他的理论不仅改变了经济学学科本身，也深刻影响了20世纪后半叶的经济政策制定。在流行文化中，凯恩斯常被描绘为与哈耶克对立的象征，代表政府干预与自由市场的思想交锋。他的名言'长远来看，我们都会死去'已成为经济学界广为流传的名句，体现了对短期经济干预必要性的强调。凯恩斯的思想遗产复杂而持久，至今仍在经济政策辩论中占据核心位置。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Keynes is regarded as a pivotal figure in the history of economic thought, successfully shifting economics from micro-level individual behavior to macroeconomic aggregate analysis. His theories not only transformed the discipline itself but profoundly influenced economic policymaking in the latter half of the 20th century. In popular culture, Keynes is often depicted as an opposite figure to Hayek, symbolizing the ideological clash between government intervention and free markets. His famous quote 'In the long run, we are all dead' has become widely circulated in economic circles, emphasizing the necessity of short-term economic intervention. Keynes's intellectual legacy remains complex and enduring, still occupying a central position in economic policy debates today.

self.zh: 长远来看，我们都会死去。
self.en: In the long run, we are all dead.

others.zh: 凯恩斯不仅是本世纪最伟大的经济学家，而且可能是自亚当·斯密以来最伟大的经济学家。
others.en: Keynes was not only the greatest economist of the century but perhaps the greatest since Adam Smith.
